mapping_profile.qor_comparability: The bounded structural mapping result is a netlist-size and STA-coverage scaling proxy only. Its cell count, Liberty area, and timing are not directly comparable to cases mapped by the default delay-oriented ABC recipe.
mapping_profile.rationale: The exact 113,945-cell generic numeric_e16_l16 design remained in the pinned default quality-oriented ABC recipe for more than 64 minutes without producing a mapped netlist. The governed bounded recipe completed a real Nangate45 Liberty mapping in a preliminary exact-design experiment; it is limited to this non-equivalence, non-physical scaling point and does not resize or omit the case.

interface_alignment.policy: Exact primary-input, arbitrary-init-input, state-index/alias, and primary-output maps match before proof.

equivalence_generic.method: Full flattened RTL is normalized with async2sync and clk2fflogic; every unspecified initial state is converted to solver-controlled anyinit before the exact generic synth -flatten -noabc transform. Both sides are then converted to arbitrary-common-initial-state AIGER. Pinned ABC dsec proves every primary-output bit using exact non-overlapping partitions, recursively bisecting only undecided ranges down to one bit.
equivalence_generic.undefined_state_policy: formalff -ff2anyinit -setundef runs before generic synthesis on both proof sides. This deliberately inhibits X/don't-care state deletion and proves the synthesis transform under a stronger arbitrary-common-initial-state model; it is transformation evidence, not a claim that the separately generated mapped or ORFS netlist retains identical private state. Exact ORFS synthesized-to-final equivalence is governed separately, while qualified RTL-to-product-netlist LEC remains external.

gate.aiger_disposition: The verbose map proves each listed undriven bit is a retained primary input with the same index on both proof sides; AIGER models it as a shared arbitrary input.
